config.general.title: General
config.categories.title: Categories
config.enable.name: Enable screen shake
config.strength.name: Shake strength
config.strength.description: How strong camera shake feels. 1 is normal strength; 2 is twice as strong; 0 turns it off.
config.mining.name: Large rock breaks
config.mining.description: Shake when a pickaxe destroys a boulder, meteorite, or other large mineral clump. Ordinary rocks and ore nodes do not shake the camera.
config.combat.name: Combat specials
config.combat.description: Shake on successful defensive-sword parries. Club specials already use Stardew Valley's native shake.
config.damage.name: Player damage
config.damage.description: Shake when the local player takes damage.
config.explosions.name: Explosions
config.trees.name: Trees and hardwood
config.trees.description: Shake subtly when a wild tree felled by the local player lands, or their axe destroys a large hardwood stump or log.
